blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s conviction is unlikely to spark massive protests, with a survey showing that half of Filipinos would accept the Senate Impeachment Court’s ruling, according to Bicol Saro Rep. Terry Ridon. Ridon, one of the prosecutors in Duterte’s trial, said the vice president’s supporters may instead rally support online rather than stage protests. “There will likely be a gathering on social media for this, but I cannot say for certain if there will be physical rallies or gatherings across different parts of the Philippines,” he said in Filipino at the Saturday News Forum.
